title: NASA program with psychic kids in Florida

tellings.quote: heard a lot about that that there in the late '60s there was some somewhere in Florida there was like a NASA thing with kids.
I mean, NASA had the star kids.
tellings.difference: Calls the children 'star kids' and gives no place or date, where the story puts it in Florida in the late 1960s.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe a NASA program built around psychic children. The 'star kids' line matches the story about a NASA program with psychic kids.

as_told.title: NASA star kids remote viewing program

plain: NASA is said to have run a programme in Florida in the late 1960s that worked with psychic children. If so, the space agency was quietly studying the mind as well as rockets. A researcher named Greg Malatzi says he has "heard a lot about" a "NASA thing with kids" somewhere in Florida at that time, though he names no source. A guest named Jay Anderson mentions it in passing, saying "NASA had the star kids," without giving a place or date.
